# Data Wise Academy

> Data Wise Academy is a Menlo Park, California–based company that trains executives, managers, and analysts to turn data and AI into business impact through hands-on training courses, applied hackathons, executive master classes, and Silicon Valley learning expeditions.

AI is the future, but data is the foundation. Every program rests on the same proven frameworks (VORTEX™, FAIR, TACTICAL™, ARSENAL™, ISWEAR™), combines practical foundations with hackathons on real data, and is supported by AI & Data Facilitators. The approach is vendor-agnostic.

Contact: info@datawiseacademy.com · +1 650 387 4412 · 1285 Woodland Avenue, Menlo Park, CA 94025, USA. Pricing is provided on request.

## Programs

- [Master Data in the AI Era](https://datawiseacademy.com/program/master-data-in-the-ai-era/): Training Course, 2 days, for data project leaders, operational leadership, and Excel analysts. Take 360° control of data projects: frame the right business question, apply FAIR data and the TACTICAL™ process, and clean and prepare data at scale with Natural Language Coding.
- [Machine Learning for Business](https://datawiseacademy.com/program/machine-learning-for-business/): Training Course, 2 days, for business AI project leaders, business analysts, and BI analysts. Understand what machine learning can and cannot do, practice the full ML cycle (regression, classification, clustering, and time series) on real data, and evaluate models critically.
- [Advanced Reporting in the GenAI Era](https://datawiseacademy.com/program/advanced-reporting-in-the-genai-era/): Training Course, 2 days, for business managers, business analysts, and BI analysts. Write content once in Markdown and produce consistent, on-brand decks, dashboards, and reports, with forms that collect clean, audited data.
- [Advanced Data Wrangling and Visualization in the GenAI Era](https://datawiseacademy.com/program/advanced-data-wrangling-and-visualization/): Training Course, 2 days, for business analysts and BI analysts. Profile, cleanse, pivot, and enrich data with AI-generated Python code that you can read, audit, and trust.
- [Lead in the AI Era](https://datawiseacademy.com/program/lead-in-the-ai-era/): Executive Session, 2 hours, for executive leaders. An executive session on leading AI transformation: the VORTEX™ of mounting pressures, FAIR data, the TACTICAL™ framework, and what to sponsor, fund, and demand from teams.
- [Empowered Leadership in the AI Era](https://datawiseacademy.com/program/empowered-leadership-in-the-ai-era/): Executive Session, 3 hours, for business leaders. An executive session on creating the conditions for data, AI, ML, and GenAI to deliver reliable business value, including machine learning essentials and change management.
- [Data Governance in the AI Era](https://datawiseacademy.com/program/data-governance-in-the-ai-era/): Training Course, 1 day, for data leaders, business analysts, and BI analysts. Build data quality into the pipeline with profiling, cleansing techniques, quality rules, ownership, stewardship, and lineage.
- [Applied Hackathons](https://datawiseacademy.com/program/applied-hackathons/): Applied Hackathon, 1 or 2 days, for data project leaders, BI analysts, and Excel analysts. Teams solve a real data challenge with their own data in one or two days, supported by AI & Data Facilitators, and present the result to leadership.
- [Master Class Series](https://datawiseacademy.com/program/master-class-series/): Executive Series, 4 to 7 sessions, for executives and senior leaders, as well as business analytics and IT professionals. A curated series of executive master classes on practical analytics, AI, and GenAI techniques, delivered with experts from UC Berkeley, Stanford, Northeastern, industry, and government.
- [Silicon Valley Immersion](https://datawiseacademy.com/program/silicon-valley-immersion/): Learning Expedition, 3 to 6 days in the Bay Area, for executive teams and senior leaders, innovation and transformation leaders, and entrepreneurs and high-potential managers. A learning expedition in the San Francisco Bay Area hosted at UC Berkeley Haas, with faculty sessions, company visits, startup pitches, and networking.

## Clients

Data Wise Academy has trained teams at companies such as Allianz, Amazon, Chanel, Coca-Cola, Deloitte, ENGIE, Intel, L’Oréal, Lockheed Martin, Mastercard, Michelin, Nissan, Oracle, and Renault; business schools and universities such as HEC Paris, INSEAD, École Polytechnique, CentraleSupélec, Stanford University, and UC Berkeley; and public organizations such as the Port of Seattle, ONCF (Morocco’s national railway), and The Nature Conservancy.
